pipeline_max_export_common/edit_mesh_mod + xref_resolve: extract the Edit Mesh MeshDelta decode/apply and the XRefObject resolver into the shared library (ig+cmb had drifting inline copies); cmb wired to both; the auth-doc MeshDelta spec pinned the last modern-format MDELTA_CHUNK chunks the cmb tool needed. Chunk map now: 0x0130 = created verts (16B srcTag+Point3), 0x0208 = created BASE-topology faces (24B srcTag+v3+sm+ff), 0x0210 = created MAP-1 TEXTURE-VERTEX faces (20B v3+sm+ff — LEGACY TOPO_NTVFACES equivalent, NOT variant B of 0x0208; applying it to base topology causes edge-inconsistent meshes CCollisionMeshBuild::link rejects, corpus-pinned via fy_hall_reunion face-count-248 match), 0x0220 = per-face attribute changes (12B faceIdx+applyMask+values, legacy TOPO_ATTRIBS equivalent — values bits 0..2 edges, 3 hidden, 5..20 matID; applyMask bits 0..2 per-edge apply, 3 hidden apply, 4 matID apply, split off from legacy bits 28..31). Cmb applies face-attribs (matID/edge-vis rewrites → reference's material distribution field-exact on fy_hall_reunion), created base faces (0x0208), and XRef collision-node resolution (--ligo mode; closes §10v's "6 of 1201 files produce zero output" gap). Link errors downgraded to stderr warnings + write anyway (reference plugin shipped edge-inconsistent .cmbs; matching the reference means matching that too). Direct T1/T2/T3 tiers same coarse bucket counts (10 identical + 3 float-eq + 3 diff, DIRECT_DIFF_BUDGET=3) but underlying quality massively improved — fy_hall_reunion face-index match 229/248 -> 247/248, exact material distribution; ligo tier 11+15+22+6=54 -> 30+83+41+16=170 measured igs (3x match count). Ig corpus stays green (T1/T2 116/116, T3 54/54 field-exact + 40 processed-ref match, ligo_ig DIFF_BUDGET=8 exit 0) — the refactor is behavior-preserving there. Open follow-ups: created-vert position offset on fy_hall_reunion (candidate 0x2510 mod-context TM applied to created verts, unproven); the one face-vertex-remap chunk (modern equivalent of legacy TOPO_FACEMAP_CHUNK 0x2780, not yet identified in corpus MDELTA_CHUNK sub-trees); zo_bt_hall_reunion_vitrine larger-scale same class; zo_bt_Hall_Conseil vertex offset still open on its own separate terms
